title: It's okay
text: It's okay. I am unsure what the price for this was when I bought it but material wasn't so good, it looks just like the picture but I used normal scotch tape on it and it came down undone completely, one use only for sure. I was not really expecting it to last too long but didn't think I'd have to use it only one time. Also the plastic was sticking to itself in a weird way which made it even harder to place on the door as well... For a one time thing it's okay, if you want it to keep using it constantly it is not going to last much.
